name: schema047-suites-v3

name: schema047-quality-v3
cmd:
bun install --frozen-lockfile && fail=0; check() { label=$1; shift; echo "BEGIN $label"; "$@"; code=$?; echo "CHECK $label EXIT=$code"; if [ "$code" != 0 ]; then fail=1; fi; }; check scoped-ts bunx tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --types bun,@webgpu/types core/effect-schema.ts core/effect-schema.types.ts core/effect-schema.test.ts core/effect.test.ts core/exports.test.ts examples/effect.ts; check repo-ts bunx tsc -p . --pretty false; check scoped-lint bunx oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config core/effect-schema.ts core/effect-schema.types.ts core/effect-schema.test.ts core/effect.test.ts core/exports.test.ts examples/effect.ts scripts/test-shards.ts; check repo-lint bun run lint; check build bun scripts/build.ts; check package-absent sh scripts/smoke.sh; check package-schema sh scripts/smoke-effect-schema.sh; check ci-list sh -c 'bun scripts/test-shards.ts --list | grep core/effect-schema.test.ts'; tmp=$(mktemp -d); npm install --prefix "$tmp" --no-audit --no-fund --silent @commitlint/cli @commitlint/config-conventional; printf '%s
' 'feat(effect): add typed schema kinds with explicit precision' > "$tmp/message"; check commitlint "$tmp/node_modules/.bin/commitlint" --extends "$tmp/node_modules/@commitlint/config-conventional/lib/index.js" --edit "$tmp/message"; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $fail
